checkin: When to Meet We recommend arriving 20 minutes prior to your trip's departure. Unfortunately, there is no public parking at the Charleston Maritime Center. We suggest parking at the Aquarium Garage (which is about a block away) or at a parking meter on Concord Street. Parking meters are free after 6:00pm and all day on Sundays.

There are no refunds or reschedules within 72 hours of your charter.

quotes.author: Ernie B / Charleston
quotes.text: Four of us did a sunset sail and it was the perfect ending to an awesome day. It's great to be out in our beautiful harbor with such a knowledgeable and skilled guide. Brian made us feel right at home on his boat and was quick to point out any points of interest including the local wildlife. Would do it again it again without hesitation!
